scanScope.files: All 10,554 blob paths in game Source commit 7e662fcda16219d775b84af50322be2e9cd9d62e
scanScope.hashFunction: MurmurHash64A over exact UTF-8 candidate bytes, seed 0; compare high 32 bits to the 8-hex inventory hash.
scanScope.decimalChecks: Unsigned and signed 32-bit integer spellings of each target hash.
scanScope.candidateKeyContext: Every candidate hit was associated with its fixed Source path; a hash match is a candidate only and requires usage-context review.
notParsed: Lua string concatenation or runtime string construction
dynamic aliases or computed localization IDs
external Flow, VO, or other shipped game asset instances
compiled/runtime behavior beyond the static Source tree

The fixed Source tree supplies no key-to-hash, hash-to-VO-event, or hash-to-Flow-node relation. Flow IDs may arrive from external runtime/asset parameters. Speaker, event, and playback remain unconfirmed.
